doc_friction.issue: Ranked the distutils-precedence.pth row #3 with only 3 reports, but grepping run records for 'distutils' found 10 across 6 days; reports filed under different paths (container, the .pth, cloud-session.md) are not grouped.
Three records asked for a note on the traceback here; the cause was a pyenv.py side effect, so the fix belonged in the tool instead (cloud-session.md is owner-gated anyway).

notes: Backlog had only owner rows, so Critique mode. main_health.py on main: 250/250 pass. Reproduced: python3.13 -m pip install --break-system-packages setuptools==84.2.1 uninstalled Debian setuptools 68.1.2 from the shared /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages, orphaning distutils-precedence.pth. Fix: pyenv.pip_install backs up/restores the shared setuptools files; main() parks an orphaned .pth. Verified: test_pyenv 41 OK; real pip upgrade via pyenv.pip_install restored the files, 3.11/3.12 import setuptools 68.1.2, 3.13 imports 84.2.1, no traceback. No backlog ids touched; no agent doc, the post and the pyenv.py docstring carry the finding.
